scenes.narration: Safeguard: Compliant privacy and payment gateway for Stellar confidential tokens.

Confidential tokens on Stellar encrypt amounts and balances to protect privacy. But without visibility, proving compliance is difficult. Retrospective reports cannot prevent violations; compliance decisions must occur inside the transaction before funds move.

Safeguard provides that in-transaction gate across four coordinated tiers: Soroban smart contracts on Stellar Testnet, our TypeScript client SDK, a live Next.js Web3 console on Vercel, and a developer documentation hub with a zero-drift policy simulator.

Execution is fail-closed. Transfers invoke the Soroban payment gateway, checking spend caps and evaluating policy rules. Compliant transfers settle immediately. Flagged transfers route securely into escrow, while violations revert instantly at the contract level.

Treasury teams monitor spend caps and escrows via our live Web3 console on Vercel. In parallel, developers can test policies directly in our documentation simulator, running the exact decision engine client-side with zero latency.

Every contract is live on Stellar Testnet. The codebase features over 850 automated tests, 270 machine-checked error codes, measured fees of 0.001 XLM, and 200 scoped contribution issues for the Stellar Drips Wave.
Privacy and compliance are no longer a trade-off. Visit safeguard-dashboard-mocha.vercel.app, read the documentation, and start building with Safeguard on GitHub today.
